# Bouldspace

> Bouldspace is a premier architectural consultancy, project management consultancy (PMC), and turnkey design-build studio headquartered in India. The studio delivers ultra-premium architecture, technical spatial planning, bespoke interior curation, precision modular kitchens, luxury renovations, and comprehensive turnkey execution from concept to completion.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Services Overview](https://bouldspace.com/services): Comprehensive index of Bouldspace's 8 spatial design and engineering execution capabilities.
- [Architecture Planning](https://bouldspace.com/services/architecture): Visionary spatial design, load-bearing engineering, bioclimatic orientation, and parametric facades.
- [Interior Curation](https://bouldspace.com/services/interior-design): High-end sensory living environments, custom travertine overlays, tailored casework, and acoustic clay treatments.
- [Modular Kitchens](https://bouldspace.com/services/modular-kitchen): Precision culinary centers featuring zero-gap obsidian oak casework, monolithic travertine islands, and integrated downdraft induction systems.
- [Furniture & Decor Curation](https://bouldspace.com/services/furniture-decor): Handcrafted furniture commissions, wire-brushed ash structures, and Belgian linen upholstery.
- [Home Decor & Dressing](https://bouldspace.com/services/home-decor): Final sensory styling, ambient cove lighting channels, curated sculptures, and tactile fabric dressing.
- [Renovations & Retrofits](https://bouldspace.com/services/renovations): Structural volume overhauls, high-pressure concrete column jackets (<0.05% deflection tolerance), and partition removals.
- [Project Management Consultancy (PMC)](https://bouldspace.com/services/pmc): Critical Path Method (CPM) scheduling, independent quality audits, ultrasonic concrete testing, and zero-defect delivery control.
- [Turnkey Design-Build Solutions](https://bouldspace.com/services/turnkey): Single-point accountability managing architecture, engineering, procurement, civil casting, and styling with a 10-year structural warranty.

## Methodology & Portfolio

- [Development Process](https://bouldspace.com/process): The 6-chapter design-to-handover operational protocol detailing discovery, strategy, optimization, coordination, execution, and reveal.
- [Featured Projects](https://bouldspace.com/projects): Curated monograph of landmark commissions including The Travertine Pavilion, The Concrete Metamorphosis, Hotel Classic Sapphire, and Hotel Lilac.
- [Design Idea Gallery](https://bouldspace.com/gallery): Visual inspiration catalogue categorized by architectural spaces (Bathrooms, Dining, Doors, Dressing, Bedrooms, Kitchens, Living Areas).
- [Operating Sectors](https://bouldspace.com/sectors): Specialized spatial execution across Luxury Residential, Commercial & Corporate, Institutional Masterplans, and Industrial & Precision sectors.

## Consultations, Site Visits & Pricing

- [Pricing & Engagement Models](https://bouldspace.com/pricing): Transparent scoping frameworks including Design Retainers, Percentage-of-Cost Turnkey Models, and PMC fee structures.
- **Site Visit Evaluation**:
  - *Local / Same City On-Site Assessment*: ₹2,500 – ₹7,500 (100% credited against conceptual retainer if client proceeds).
  - *Outstation Site Visits*: Base consultation quoted on parcel scope (starts at ₹15,000) with transit and lodging billed at actual cost with zero markups.
- [Knowledge FAQ](https://bouldspace.com/faq): Answers to technical standards, structural warranties, milestone schedules, and damp-proofing retrofits.
